content.heading: graphbrowser - the dependency graph, one layer at a time
content: **graphbrowser** describes a website's external dependency graph one layer at a time, as structured markdown with hyperlinks for navigating between graph nodes.

content.heading: the graph a page exposes
content: every webpage names its dependencies - the navigable items a reader can move to. one layer of that graph is the page's own set of links; the next layer lives one hop away.
**graphbrowser** renders that walk as a GUI: page dependencies visualised without having to view the page content, node by node, link by link.
it is the GUI counterpart of [**pagerts**](/projects/pagerts), built with Quarkus and web technologies - the same dependency list pagerts parses with JSDOM into `title`, `url` and `resources`.

content.heading: the package, architecturally
content: a Quarkus application whose UI renders each graph node as structured markdown; every node's outbound links are the hyperlinks to the next nodes - the traversal IS the document.
